mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CALENDAR_DATE ( CAL_DATE, SOLAR_YEAR, SOLAR_MONTH, SOLAR_DAY, DAY_OF_WEEK, DAY_OF_WEEK_NAME, WEEK_OF_YEAR, WEEK_OF_MONTH, QUARTER, LUNAR_YEAR, LUNAR_MONTH, LUNAR_DAY, IS_LEAP_MONTH, LUNAR_DISPLAY, IS_HOLIDAY, HOLIDAY_NAME, HOLIDAY_TYPE, IS_WORKDAY ) VALUES ( #{calDate}, #{solarYear}, #{solarMonth}, #{solarDay}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{dayOfWeekName}, #{weekOfYear}, #{weekOfMonth}, #{quarter}, #{lunarYear}, #{lunarMonth}, #{lunarDay}, #{isLeapMonth}, #{lunarDisplay}, #{isHoliday}, #{holidayName}, #{holidayType}, #{isWorkday} )
